vulnerabilityTitle: Ingress Packet Burst Flood & Oversized MTU
summary: Added MTU ceiling (65,535 B) and adaptive ingress rate limiter (1,200 req/s) in standby slot before atomic swap.
rootCause: Ingress filter validated destination port only, allowing high-rate burst floods and oversized frames to exhaust socket buffers.

diffLines.content: // Contract: function execute(input, env) -> { ok: boolean, allowed: boolean, action: 'accept' | 'drop', reason: string }
return { ok: false, allowed: false, action: 'drop', reason: 'Malformed packet' };

environmentImpact: Reduced tail latency during burst traffic by rejecting oversized packets prior to scheduler IPC enqueue.
